program:
PARAMS = {
    "W1":  (4.0, 1.5, 12.0),     # gain NMOS width (um)
    "L1":  (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),      # gain NMOS length
    "Wsf": (8.0, 3.0, 20.0),     # follower width
    "Lsf": (0.35, 0.2, 0.8),     # follower length
    "Wpu": (4.0, 2.0, 10.0),     # PMOS mirror unit width (per 2 uA)
    "Wnu": (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),      # NMOS mirror unit width (per 2 uA)
    "Rf":  (5.0e5, 4.3e5, 7.0e5),
    "Cf":  (5e-15, 1e-15, 15e-15),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    LM = 1.0
    k_ref, k_tail, k_pb, k_pd, k_pl = 5, 2, 1, 1, 3
    iu = iref / k_ref
    I1, Isf, Ipb = k_pl * iu, k_tail * iu, k_pb * iu

    W1, L1, Wsf, Lsf = p["W1"], p["L1"], p["Wsf"], p["Lsf"]
    Wpu, Wnu, Rf, Cf = p["Wpu"], p["Wnu"], p["Rf"], p["Cf"]

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", k_ref * Wnu, LM)
    n.M("MN2", "vout",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", k_tail * Wnu, LM)
    n.M("MN3", "pb",    "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", k_pb * Wnu, LM)
    n.M("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", k_pd * Wpu, LM)
    n.M("MP1", "vx", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", k_pl * Wpu, LM)
    n.M("M1",  "vx",  "iin", "vss",  "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.M("MSF", "vdd", "vx",  "vout", "vss", "nfet", Wsf, Lsf)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "iin", Cf)

    def solve_vgs(dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.1, 1.6
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] < Id: lo = mid
            else: hi = mid
        v = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        return v, lut.op(dev, W, L, v, vds, vsb)

    vg1, o1 = solve_vgs("n", W1, L1, I1, 0.6)
    vout = vg1
    vgs_sf, osf = solve_vgs("n", Wsf, Lsf, Isf, 1.8 - vout, vsb=vout)
    vx = vout + vgs_sf
    vgsp, op_ = solve_vgs("p", k_pl * Wpu, LM, I1, max(1.8 - vx, 0.1))
    o1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vg1, vx)

    gm1, gds1 = o1["gm"], o1["gds"]
    gdsp = op_["gds"]
    Rx = 1.0 / (gds1 + gdsp)
    A1 = gm1 * Rx
    gmsf = osf["gm"]
    Asf = gmsf / (gmsf + 0.2 * gmsf + osf["gds"])
    T = A1 * Asf

    cgg1 = o1.get("cgg", 8.5e-15 * W1 * L1)
    cggsf = osf.get("cgg", 8.5e-15 * Wsf * Lsf)
    cgd1 = 0.3e-15 * W1
    Cx = cgd1 + 0.8e-15 * W1 + 1.3e-15 * k_pl * Wpu + 0.3e-15 * Wsf + cggsf * (1 - Asf)
    Cin = cpd + cgg1
    tx, ti = Rx * Cx, Rf * Cin
    Cfe = Cf + cgd1 / max(Asf, 0.5)
    b = tx + ti + (1 + T) * Rf * Cfe
    w0 = math.sqrt((1 + T) / (tx * ti))
    Q = (1 + T) / (w0 * b)
    x = 1 - 1 / (2 * Q * Q)
    f3 = w0 / (2 * PI) * math.sqrt(x + math.sqrt(x * x + 1))
    f3 *= 1.0 / math.sqrt(1 + (f3 / (gmsf / (2 * PI * cl))) ** 2)

    zt = Rf * T / (1 + T)
    k = 1.380649e-23; Tk = 300.0
    in_rf = 4 * k * Tk / Rf
    vn2 = 4 * k * Tk * 0.8 * (gm1 + op_["gm"]) / gm1 ** 2
    in_amp = vn2 * (2 * PI * 1e6 * (Cin + Cf)) ** 2
    noise = math.sqrt(in_rf + in_amp)

    power = 1.8 * (iref + Ipb + I1 + Isf)
    return n, {"zt_dbohm": 20 * math.log10(zt), "f3db": f3, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout, "in_noise_1m": noise}
